name: tauriMarkerAfterUnflushedFence
covers: N4: on Tauri the recovery exit writes its marker only after the fence write reported flushed; a fence write that did not reach stable storage stops the exit before the marker, and a restart that keeps the file finds the fence again and its boot re-flush flushes it

labels.H9: the exit waits for the fence write t: r: exit seed: the fence write reports flushed:false (the flush fault of the scheduler); the exit ends fence:not-durable and writes no marker, so the damaged commit key still stands
labels.N4: the flag is lost with the re-flush: r: a Tauri restart that keeps the unflushed fence file (no power loss): the new page's boot re-flush rewrites the commit key and the fence it finds, both report flushed, and the deleters are not idle
